title: IMF Approves Second Review of $20B Program, Releases $1 Billion Disbursement
detail: The IMF Executive Board approved the second review of Argentina's $20 billion Extended Fund Facility, releasing a $1 billion disbursement and bringing cumulative disbursements to approximately $15.8 billion. The Fund revised its 2026 inflation projection upward sharply to 30.4% while maintaining a 3.5% GDP growth forecast. The IMF called for improved inflation-data quality following a methodology dispute that led to changes at INDEC earlier in 2026. The federal primary surplus is projected at 1.4% of GDP for 2026.

media.caption: IMF approves second review of Argentina's EFF program, releases $1 billion

title: Photographer Beaten and Arrested While Covering Anti-Austerity Protest in Buenos Aires
detail: Photographer Tomás Cuesta was beaten by police and arrested while covering an anti-austerity demonstration in Buenos Aires on May 21. Reporters Without Borders (RSF) documented the incident and warned of an escalating pattern of press freedom violations during the Milei era. The incident is part of a broader pattern of journalists being subjected to force when covering weekly retiree protests and other demonstrations against the government's austerity program.

media.caption: RSF documents journalist beatings and arrests at Buenos Aires anti-austerity protests
